name: Basic Hotel
beschreibung: The Basic Hotel in Innsbruck offers modern, practical accommodation situated centrally in the capital of Tyrol. The guest rooms are thoughtfully designed with functional furnishings, ensuring a comfortable and straightforward stay. Renowned attractions, including the historic Old Town and the Nordkette cable railway, are just a short walk away. Guests can effortlessly explore urban culture alongside breathtaking Alpine nature. The hotel is ideally suited for city travellers and adventurers seeking convenient, central lodging.
